correctness.rationale: A=M(P_n)=Ind(P_{n-1}), with spoke links A_i=Ind(P_{i-2})*Ind(P_{n-i-1}); the universal path recurrence from deletion of vertex 2 yields all link dimensions. The n=3k+1 first-spoke inclusion is a homotopy equivalence because its endpoint link Ind(P_{3k-2}) is contractible. Other attaching maps are null by connectivity or contraction; formal empty links cover n=2,3. This proves the integral wedge types for all n, with 14 exact finite mod-two independent checks as corroboration.

value.rationale: Fans are the basic common-apex triangulations among maximal outerplanar graphs. Whereas the motivating literature guarantees only a wedge-of-spheres outcome, this theorem determines all integral Betti numbers and optimal connectivity dimensions in a nontrivial 3-periodic pattern. The homotopy effect of a spoke cone changes qualitatively among residues: one cone kills the old sphere exactly in the n=3k+1 case.
